title: Wynonna Judd – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Wynonna Judd performs a live country music concert on The Hard Truth Tour, featuring songs from her solo career and her work as one half of The Judds. The show is Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO. Tickets are sold only through HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
